title: Efficient — A more efficient approach would be…

meaning.en: Achieving results without wasting time or effort.
meaning.taglish: Magandang result nang hindi sayang ang oras.
meaning.fil: Makakuha ng magandang resulta nang hindi nagsasayang ng oras o gamit.

examples.work: This is a more efficient process.
examples.everyday: Planning our shopping route is more efficient than visiting shops at random.

options: Achieving results without wasting time or effort.
To waste time and effort unnecessarily.
check.explanation: Efficient: Achieving results without wasting time or effort. Example: This is a more efficient process.
check.hint: Notice the meaning in this example: This is a more efficient process.

explanation.en: Efficient describes getting results with less wasted time or effort.
explanation.taglish: Ang efficient ay nakakamit ang resulta nang hindi sayang ang oras o effort.
explanation.fil: Makakuha ng magandang resulta nang hindi nagsasayang ng oras o gamit.

phrase.text: A more efficient approach would be…

meaning.en: To propose a practical way to save time or effort.
meaning.taglish: Mag-suggest ng paraan na mas makakatipid sa oras at effort.
meaning.fil: Pagbibigay ng paraan na makakatipid ng oras o effort.

examples.work: A more efficient approach would be to use a shared template.
examples.everyday: A more efficient approach would be to buy everything in one trip.

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.text: We spend a lot of time reformatting reports.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A more efficient approach would be to use a shared template.

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.text: Good idea. Can we test the template on one report?

check.prompt: Complete: 'An approach would be to ___ the files.'
check.explanation: Use the base verb after 'to': An approach would be to organize the files.
check.hint: Read the example: A more efficient approach would be to use a shared template.

grammarTip.explanation: Compare with 'more efficient': 'One shared list is more efficient than three separate lists.' Then propose the action: 'A more efficient approach would be to use one list.'

speaking.scenario: Recommend a more efficient way to organize team updates.
hints: A more efficient approach would be to prepare a shared template.
A more efficient approach would be…
speaking.oneMinuteGoal: Describe the situation, your main point, and one example.
speaking.twoMinuteGoal: Add a reason, another example, and a clear conclusion.
speaking.modelResponse: A more efficient approach would be to use a shared spreadsheet. Everyone could update their own tasks, and we would no longer need to ask for separate status reports. That could save us time each week.
selfReview: I answered the situation with a clear main message.
I included the detail or question the listener needs.
I chose one sentence to improve or practice again.
preparationQuestions: What main point do you want to share?

durationGuidance.en: One and two minutes are optional practice targets, not minimums. A shorter complete message counts. Start with two or three sentences, then add detail if useful.
durationGuidance.taglish: Optional targets lang ang isa o dalawang minuto. Puwedeng mas maikli basta malinaw ang mensahe. Magsimula sa dalawa o tatlong pangungusap.
durationGuidance.fil: Gabay lamang ang isa o dalawang minuto, hindi kailangang abutin. Sapat ang mas maikling sagot kung malinaw ang mensahe.

speaking.modelResponseNote: This is one short example, not a script to memorize or a timed one-minute answer. Your details and wording may differ.
